video.desc:
Ethan spent ten years searching for the boy who pulled him from the water when he was drowning. When he finally tracked down Landon, he transferred to the University of California just to get close to him—only to discover that Landon was hopelessly in love with their swimming coach, Aaron.
So Ethan made a move of his own. He started flirting with Coach Aaron right in front of Landon, just to make him jealous. Then, under the guise of "teaching Landon how to win someone over..
Ethan花了十年时间，寻找那个在他溺水时把他从水里拉上来的男孩。当他终于找到Landon后，他转学到加州大学，只为接近对方，却发现Landon无可救药地爱着他们的游泳教练Aaron。
于是Ethan也出手了。他开始当着Landon的面和Aaron教练调情，只为让他吃醋。接着，他又打着"教Landon怎么追人"的幌子……
